gen-gf-phudu-gf-teachers: Bold, chunky Phudu handles the shouting with generous openings on every curve. And Teachers, a thin, modern sans with strokes that taper out before touching, does the quiet work of carrying the details.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-telex: Telex reads smooth and rounded, loose in its curves and easy on the eye. Phudu earns its keep big and brief, where its single stroke width runs through the whole alphabet like poured ink.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tenor-sans: Phudu draws everything with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, bold and unmistakable. Tenor Sans follows with light but visible stroke variation, soft accents of heavier strokes giving the text a gentle reading rhythm.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tirra: Chunky and open-faced, Phudu looks like it was drawn with a pen that never changes pressure. But Tirra's round forms, like open parentheses, give the plain sans text a softer, more modern finish.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-titillium-web: Approachable is the first word for Titillium Web, though Phudu leads with bold letters built from one width of stroke. Titillium Web follows with stroke ends set far apart, making a lighter, contemporary counterweight to that heavy top line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tomorrow: Clean and quiet describes Tomorrow, whose bowls open like a cupped palm of clay beneath Phudu's level, accent-free beat. And over a longer passage the sans-serif text keeps moving without fuss, never tugging attention back to the heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-trispace: Poured-ink heft meets sparse spacing here, with Phudu fat and Trispace wide and loose. And since Trispace spreads out so generously, a slightly smaller size for it would probably keep the sans text snug under the heading.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Clean and rounded, Tsukimi Rounded is the quiet half. Its stroke edges run parallel through every curve, so a long stretch of the sans text flows smoothly while Phudu's bold, open-ended letters stay up top.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tuffy: Loud heading, pencil-light text. Tuffy sketches its letters with a line that never presses harder, leaving a widely parted s, and that lightness lets Phudu's bold shapes stand out above it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-urbanist: Contemporary Urbanist brings a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, and that is where it does its best work as plain sans text. But Phudu is built to be bold and distinctive, with generous openings that make a heading hard to ignore.
